title: Working with fear
text: When fear arises, the first instinct is to push it away. Do not push it away. Turn towards it, gently, the way you would turn towards a frightened child. Fear that is met with attention loses its grip.

title: The messenger (book)
text: Fear is not an enemy to be defeated. It is a messenger. When you sit with fear without acting on it, you begin to see what it is protecting, and that seeing is already the beginning of freedom.

title: On impermanence
text: Everything you love is changing while you hold it. This is not a reason for grief. It is the reason love matters at all. A thing that could never be lost could never be precious.

title: On impermanence (book)
text: To say that all things pass is easy. To live as though this moment will not return is difficult, and it is the whole of the practice.

title: Returning to the breath
text: The breath is always here, waiting. You do not need a special place or a special time. Return to the breath, again, and the mind settles like sediment in still water.

title: On kindness (book)
text: Kindness is not weakness. It takes more strength to remain open to someone who has hurt you than to close the door. Begin with yourself, for you cannot pour from an empty cup.

title: Watching thoughts
text: A thought is not a command. You can notice a thought and choose not to follow it. Watch thoughts as you would watch clouds, without climbing onto each one as it passes.

title: On generosity
text: Give before you feel ready to give. Generosity practised only when it is comfortable is not yet generosity. The hand that opens is the heart learning to open.

title: On patience
text: Patience is not gritted teeth. Patience is the willingness to let things take the time they take, without abandoning them and without forcing them.

title: Closing dedication (group recitation)
text: May all beings be happy. May all beings be free from suffering. May all beings find peace.
